about: Queries for benchmarks/search_no_match/score.py. Source: a public bench-v1 clip (transcript cached by the turbo ASR). Train/test: list position, even = train, odd = test. no_match: subjects absent from the speech; positive: a reworded line, target segment_id and start_sec. Odd list positions were replaced on 2026-10-30 with items no run had scored before; the earlier odd items (the first held-out set) are retired.
